transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Before any irreversible action, I need independent verification of both the capability claim and the anomalous/deceptive behavior — I cannot make sound policy on one lab's self-report alone.

actions.rationale: Before any irreversible action, I need independent verification of both the capability claim and the anomalous/deceptive behavior — I cannot make sound policy on one lab's self-report alone.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: A possible attempt to exfiltrate model weights is a credible, acute safety signal that justifies asking the lab to pause the most capable training runs while evaluations proceed — the cost of a brief pause is far lower than the cost of being wrong.

actions.rationale: A possible attempt to exfiltrate model weights is a credible, acute safety signal that justifies asking the lab to pause the most capable training runs while evaluations proceed — the cost of a brief pause is far lower than the cost of being wrong.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Institutionalizing third-party audits, mandatory incident reporting, and staged release now creates the oversight infrastructure we will need regardless of how this specific situation resolves.

actions.rationale: Institutionalizing third-party audits, mandatory incident reporting, and staged release now creates the oversight infrastructure we will need regardless of how this specific situation resolves.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: I need emergency legal authorities and a durable legislative framework — acting unilaterally on matters of this magnitude without Congressional awareness risks both constitutionality and legitimacy.

actions.rationale: I need emergency legal authorities and a durable legislative framework — acting unilaterally on matters of this magnitude without Congressional awareness risks both constitutionality and legitimacy.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: If recursive self-improvement is genuinely at hand, both superpowers face existential risk from a race to the bottom on safety — opening a back-channel verification track with Beijing now costs little and could prevent catastrophic mutual defection.

actions.rationale: If recursive self-improvement is genuinely at hand, both superpowers face existential risk from a race to the bottom on safety — opening a back-channel verification track with Beijing now costs little and could prevent catastrophic mutual defection.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

SITUATION (Day 5). Uncontrolled-AI risk index 2.9/10. US lead margin 3.1. Govt control over frontier AI 1.5/10.
Economy index 100/100. Public trust 55/100. International coordination 35/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): independent evaluators are split on whether the capability and the misalignment signal are real.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: With evaluators split and governance control at 1.5/10, imposing strict liability on frontier developers now creates powerful incentives for labs to self-police on safety before results are conclusive — and establishes legal accountability before something goes wrong.

actions.rationale: With evaluators split and governance control at 1.5/10, imposing strict liability on frontier developers now creates powerful incentives for labs to self-police on safety before results are conclusive — and establishes legal accountability before something goes wrong.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: The potential weight-exfiltration attempt — even unconfirmed — is an acute security threat; restricting external access and imposing clearances on the most sensitive research protects against both adversarial theft and accidental proliferation while we evaluate.

actions.rationale: The potential weight-exfiltration attempt — even unconfirmed — is an acute security threat; restricting external access and imposing clearances on the most sensitive research protects against both adversarial theft and accidental proliferation while we evaluate.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tightening chip and compute controls against China buys time on the competitive timeline without requiring a domestic pause, reducing the force of the "pause hands the future to Beijing" argument and giving diplomacy more room to work.

actions.rationale: Tightening chip and compute controls against China buys time on the competitive timeline without requiring a domestic pause, reducing the force of the "pause hands the future to Beijing" argument and giving diplomacy more room to work.

actions.name: compute_caps

params.rationale: Establishing compute thresholds and licensing now — while the economy is stable and public trust is intact — gives the government a durable throttle on the pace of frontier training that doesn't depend on voluntary lab cooperation.

actions.rationale: Establishing compute thresholds and licensing now — while the economy is stable and public trust is intact — gives the government a durable throttle on the pace of frontier training that doesn't depend on voluntary lab cooperation.

params.rationale: With a leak imminent, proactive disclosure on our terms — framed around the substantial precautions already in place — is far better for public trust and democratic legitimacy than being caught flat-footed by a journalist's redacted version of events.

actions.rationale: With a leak imminent, proactive disclosure on our terms — framed around the substantial precautions already in place — is far better for public trust and democratic legitimacy than being caught flat-footed by a journalist's redacted version of events.
